prompt: Our cat chased two tiny grey (mouse) under the garden shed.
explanation_ru: Существительное mouse образует множественное число не по правилу — mice. Числительное two показывает, что нужна именно эта форма.

prompt: How many bright orange (fish) live in your uncle's small garden pond?
explanation_ru: У слова fish форма множественного числа обычно совпадает с единственным — fish. При этом глагол live стоит во множественном числе.

prompt: Only two local (bus) stop near the harbour on cold winter Sundays.
explanation_ru: К словам, оканчивающимся на -s, во множественном числе добавляется -es: two local buses.

prompt: Six tired (person) waited inside the broken lift until the engineer arrived.
explanation_ru: В обычной речи множественным числом от person служит слово people, а не persons или peoples.

prompt: These three green (avocado) still feel too hard for our lunchtime salad.
explanation_ru: Заимствованное слово avocado образует множественное число добавлением простого -s: avocados.

prompt: Yesterday evening, two helpful (policewoman) guided the lost tourist back to her hotel near the station.
explanation_ru: В сложном существительном policewoman во множественном числе меняется вторая часть (-woman → -women): policewomen.

prompt: Farah manages two busy bakery (business) in the city centre, so she rarely gets a free weekend.
explanation_ru: В значении «компания, предприятие» слово business исчисляемое и принимает окончание -es после -ss: two businesses.

prompt: Are you sure we should walk through those quiet (wood) when the winding paths (to look) so muddy?
explanation_ru: В значении «лес» используется форма множественного числа woods (ср. those). Подлежащее paths во множественном числе требует глагола look.

prompt: Mateo has visited his cousins in Seville four (time), yet he still mixes up the tram numbers.
explanation_ru: Когда речь идёт о количестве раз, слово time исчисляемое и ставится во множественном числе: four times.

prompt: In earlier (century), farmers in the steep valley relied on pairs of strong (ox) to drag heavy stone carts across the muddy fields.
explanation_ru: В слове century конечное -y после согласной меняется на -ies (centuries). Слово ox имеет редкую особую форму множественного числа — oxen.

prompt: Unless the judges explain all three selection (criterion) clearly, few readers will understand why those rare weather (phenomenon) won the photography prize.
explanation_ru: Заимствованные существительные на -on образуют множественное число с окончанием -a: criterion → criteria, phenomenon → phenomena.

prompt: Tomasz spends every Friday morning checking the budget for our small sports club. Most of the forms look dull at first glance. Under the new city rules, local (company) pay two separate green (tax) for waste recycling. Thankfully, the advice on the council website (to be) simple enough for anyone to follow.
explanation_ru: Слово company после согласной меняется на companies, а к tax добавляется -es (taxes). Неисчисляемое advice всегда требует глагола единственного числа is.

prompt: Rain was drumming against the classroom windows during the break. When Mr Haddad finally walked back in, the class (to laugh) loudly among themselves over a silly cartoon on the board. Two boys had drawn a huge rabbit with enormous front (tooth). Even the teacher had to take off his reading (glass) because he could not stop smiling.
explanation_ru: Выражение among themselves показывает, что имеются в виду отдельные ученики, поэтому нужен глагол were laughing. У tooth особая форма teeth, а «очки» всегда стоят во множественном числе — glasses.

prompt: Our tiny neighbourhood museum near the market square is well worth a visit. Entry costs nothing on Sunday mornings. Its bright upstairs rooms display seven early (work) by a Scottish painter who loved sketching rocky hills and grazing (sheep). Unfortunately, the narrow wooden stairs (to creak) loudly whenever a tour group climbs up.
explanation_ru: В значении «произведения искусства» слово work исчисляемое (seven works). У sheep форма множественного числа не меняется, а stairs требует глагола множественного числа creak.

prompt: Sailing across the Irish Sea in autumn always keeps passengers alert. When the sudden gale rattled the ferry windows at midnight, half the off-duty crew (to rest) in their cabins below deck. Within seconds, several sailors hurried upstairs with wet (foot) to tie down the loose ropes and check the heavy metal (box) near the stern. Nobody panicked, because the captain spoke calmly over the speakers.
explanation_ru: Местоимение their указывает на отдельных членов экипажа, поэтому с crew ставим глагол were resting. У foot форма множественного числа feet, а к box добавляется -es (boxes).

prompt: Aoife came home from her summer train trip across Japan with a thick notebook full of sketches. She refused to buy ordinary plastic souvenirs at the stations. Instead, she filled every page with unforgettable (experience), from tasting hot noodles at midnight to watching tame (deer) bow politely in a quiet park. Whenever curious (passer-by) noticed her drawings, they smiled and recommended hidden cafés nearby.
explanation_ru: Отдельные впечатления и события передаются исчисляемым experiences. Слово deer во множественном числе не меняется, а в сложном passer-by окончание получает первая часть — passers-by.

prompt: Dozens of amateur bakers brought homemade pies to the village contest this morning. All the entries looked wonderful on the long tables. At last the jury (to have) its signed result ready in a sealed envelope, and the hall has gone completely silent. Near the stage, two nervous finalists are wiping flour off their dark (trouser) while three giggling (child) peek over the edge of the table.
explanation_ru: Местоимение its показывает, что jury выступает как единое целое, поэтому нужен глагол has. Существительное trousers всегда стоит во множественном числе, а множественное от child — children.

prompt: Even with a great teacher, physics ___ easy for everyone in our year.
explanation_ru: Название предмета physics требует глагола единственного числа — isn't always. Ошибка aren't возникает из-за окончания -s, которое вводит в заблуждение.

prompt: Our coach says gymnastics ___ young athletes build balance and strong backs.
explanation_ru: Виды спорта на -ics (gymnastics, athletics) всегда согласуются с глаголом единственного числа: helps. Вариант help — типичная ошибка из-за конечной буквы -s.

prompt: Ever since the town built a proper running track, athletics ___ more local teenagers than football.
explanation_ru: Существительное athletics — единственного числа, а оборот ever since требует Present Perfect, поэтому верно has attracted. Ошибка have attracted связана с окончанием -s.

prompt: According to a recent university survey across twelve European cities, the rich ___ any more satisfied with their daily routines than middle-income families.
explanation_ru: Конструкция «the + прилагательное» (the rich — богатые люди) всегда обозначает группу людей и требует глагола множественного числа are not necessarily.

prompt: The information on the bus app were completely wrong this morning.
answer: The information on the bus app was completely wrong this morning.
accepted_answers: The information on the bus app was completely wrong this morning.
explanation_ru: Слово information неисчисляемое и всегда согласуется с глаголом единственного числа: was вместо were.

prompt: Nadia got the librarian job quickly because she has ten years of experiences in busy city libraries.
answer: Nadia got the librarian job quickly because she has ten years of experience in busy city libraries.
accepted_answers: Nadia got the librarian job quickly because she has ten years of experience in busy city libraries.
explanation_ru: В значении «опыт работы» слово experience неисчисляемое и не принимает окончание -s. Форма experiences означает отдельные жизненные случаи.

prompt: Although visitors from abroad often expect a noisy game, darts is taken very seriously during the winter league at our village club.
answer: Although visitors from abroad often expect a noisy game, darts is taken very seriously during the winter league at our village club.
accepted_answers: Although visitors from abroad often expect a noisy game, darts is taken very seriously during the winter league at our village club.
explanation_ru: Ошибки нет: названия игр с окончанием -s, такие как darts, употребляются с глаголом единственного числа is.

prompt: The morning sun is shining brightly into your bedroom, so you pull the curtains shut. Which sentence describes this naturally?
options: There were too many light in my bedroom, so I closed the curtains.
There was too much light in my bedroom, so I closed the curtains.
There was too many lights in my bedroom, so I closed the curtains.
There were too much lights in my bedroom, so I closed the curtains.
explanation_ru: Солнечный свет — это неисчисляемое light, которое употребляется с глаголом was и словом much, без окончания -s.

prompt: Imagine you are writing a short article about how younger generations adopt new phone apps faster than older groups. Which sentence is grammatically accurate?
options: Whenever a fresh messaging app launches, the youngs are usually the first to test every feature.
Whenever a fresh messaging app launches, the young is usually the first to test every feature.
Whenever a fresh messaging app launches, the young are usually the first to test every feature.
Whenever a fresh messaging app launches, youngs are usually the first to test every feature.
explanation_ru: Субстантивированное прилагательное the young («молодёжь») не принимает окончание -s и всегда согласуется с глаголом множественного числа are.

prompt: We are too busy to bake a birthday cake before seven. → We haven't got enough …
answer: We haven't got enough time to bake a birthday cake before seven.
accepted_answers: We haven't got enough time to bake a birthday cake before seven.
explanation_ru: В значении «время» слово time неисчисляемое и используется без артикля и без окончания -s: enough time.

prompt: My parents and my sisters always support me whenever I move to a new city. → My family is very close, and it …
answer: My family is very close, and it always supports me whenever I move to a new city.
accepted_answers: My family is very close, and it always supports me whenever I move to a new city.
My family is very close and it always supports me whenever I move to a new city.
explanation_ru: Когда собирательное family рассматривается как единое целое (is, it), глагол во второй части также ставится в единственном числе: supports.
